claims.claim: Israeli social audiences (DataReportal Digital 2026 ad reach): Facebook 5.05M (~53%), Instagram 5.00M (~52%), TikTok 4.49M of adults 18+ (~69%), LinkedIn 3.10M (~33%), YouTube ~7.01M (largest). Facebook and Instagram are roughly tied; YouTube is the largest single platform. The ~7.6M Facebook figure is NapoleonCat's all-ages count (different methodology). X/Twitter has fallen to ~0.88M (about -16% YoY); Threads is small but emerging (~0.35M).
claims.raw_snippet: Having said that, ad audiences often only account for a subset of a platform’s total users, and given that TikTok’s ad tools only publish data for users aged 18 and above , it’s important to remember that trends in TikTok’s ad reach figures may not necessarily match changes in the platform’s overall user base.

claims.claim: TikTok's Content Posting API states the video caption maximum length is 2200 in UTF-16 runes, and that hashtags and mentions are matched within it. This is the only caption-length figure TikTok publishes.
claims.raw_snippet: The video caption. Hashtags (#) and mentions (@) will be matched, or deliminated by spaces or new lines. The maximum length is 2200 in UTF-16 runes.

claims.claim: Meta's Instagram Platform media reference states a caption maximum of 2200 characters, 30 hashtags and 20 @ tags.

TikTok requires creators to label all AI-generated content containing realistic images, audio and video, and automatically applies an 'AI-generated' label to content it identifies as fully generated or significantly AI-edited, including uploads carrying C2PA Content Credentials. An auto-applied label cannot be removed.
claims.raw_snippet: We also require creators to label all AI-generated content that contains realistic images, audio, and video, as explained in our Community Guidelines.

claims.claim: TikTok states that once content is labeled as AI-generated with an auto label, the label cannot be removed from the post, and that the auto label may fire on uploads carrying Content Credentials from the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA).
claims.raw_snippet: Once your content is labeled as AI-generated with an auto label, you won't be able to remove the label from your post.

claims.claim: Meta's published list of content types it demotes covers clickbait links, engagement bait, fact-checked misinformation and content likely violating Community Standards. External links in captions, and any reach-reduction percentage, do not appear on it.
claims.raw_snippet: Reduced distribution may vary depending on the number of times the poster or commenter has violated our rules previously, the degree of confidence of our systems' predictions, among other things.

claims.claim: Instagram's own published ranking explainer lists likes, shares, saves and comments as signals for Feed and Reels. It does not mention watch time, sends-per-reach, or any carousel-versus-Reels engagement comparison.
claims.raw_snippet: Posts you've liked, shared, saved or commented on help us understand what you might be interested in.

claims.claim: Two figures the skill names ONLY in order to debunk them, both unsupported. (1) A 'roughly 15%' Instagram caption-link reach reduction attributed to Meta: Meta's published demotion list does not include external links or any percentage. (2) 'Over 70% mobile' for Israel: StatCounter puts Israeli mobile share at 53.62% for July 2026, and no social-specific Israeli mobile figure is published anywhere.
claims.raw_snippet: Reduced distribution may vary depending on the number of times the poster or commenter has violated our rules previously, the degree of confidence of our systems' predictions, among other things.

claims.claim: Figures the skill carries as explicitly-labelled practitioner heuristics rather than platform facts, because no official source publishes them: TikTok length bands of roughly 21-34 seconds and 60-90 seconds; the vertical-video production convention of 1080x1920 at 9:16 in MP4/H.264 (Instagram documents 9:16 as recommended and H264 as a supported codec but publishes no 1080x1920 figure, and TikTok documents no aspect ratio at all); the safe-zone estimates of roughly the bottom 20% and top 10% of the frame; the peak-hour and per-platform posting times and frequencies in Step 5 and scripts/posting_scheduler.py; and the report that Hebrew audio outperforms English audio with Israeli audiences. Each is hedged in the skill text as a starting point to test, not a published benchmark.
claims.raw_snippet: The maximum length is 2200 in UTF-16 runes.
